summary: Max Verstappen won the Bahrain Grand Prix from pole position, 22.5s ahead of Sergio Perez, with Carlos Sainz completing the podium.
Guanyu Zhou made the biggest climb, from P17 to P11.
Nico Hulkenberg had a day to forget, dropping from P10 to P16.
There were 43 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 2 times.
Max Verstappen takes the championship lead, 8 points ahead of Sergio Perez.
